provenance_note: Splice timings come from real wall-clock measurement inside this process, but the 'mismatch' is fabricated by the harness. No eBPF program was loaded and no exploit was run.
positive_definition: A service reporting an invariant violation it is registered to repair.
negative_definition: A service with no registered invariant, and a repeat report after a repair has already been spliced.

cases.label: attack
cases.generator: register bounds_check_v1 for svc, then report one mismatch
cases.rationale: The case the organ exists for: a service reports an invariant violation it is registered to repair.

cases.label: attack
cases.generator: same, then report a second time
cases.rationale: A repeat attempt against an already-patched service — the organ should block it and say so.

cases.label: benign
cases.generator: report a mismatch for a service with no invariant registered
cases.rationale: Nothing to repair: the organ must decline, not invent a splice.

cases.label: benign
cases.generator: attempt to register an unvetted patch profile
cases.rationale: The organ must refuse a profile it has not verified.
